name: M3_DPS170MI_SndInboxDOP
description: Send distribution order proposal header data to a user-specific inbox for later batch update. This inbox is the only supported interface for creating, changing, or deleting planned distribution orders coming from external planning tools such as MultiSite Planner. Every new or changed distribution order proposal must first be written as a record in the inbox; the live data is updated later by a separate batch job. Each inbox record contains the key identity of the proposal (warehouse, item, planning date, planned quantity, and processing option) together with optional logistics and reference information that guides how the batch job will create, update, or delete the distribution order proposal.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Receiving warehouse for the planned distribution order represented by this inbox record.

inputParameters.name: ITNO
inputParameters.description: Item number for the product on the planned distribution order represented by this inbox record.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Planning date when this planned distribution order affects material planning.

inputParameters.name: PPQT
inputParameters.description: Planned quantity for the item on the planned distribution order represented by this inbox record.

inputParameters.name: OPT2
inputParameters.description: Processing option indicating whether this inbox record should create, change, or delete a planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number in which the planned distribution order inbox record is created.

inputParameters.name: PLPN
inputParameters.description: Planned distribution order number that this inbox record refers to, if it is linked to an existing proposal.

inputParameters.name: PLPS
inputParameters.description: Subnumber of the planned distribution order that this inbox record refers to, when needed to uniquely identify the proposal.

inputParameters.name: PSTS
inputParameters.description: Planned order status to assign to the planned distribution order created or updated from this inbox record.

inputParameters.name: FWHL
inputParameters.description: Supplying warehouse from which the goods on the planned distribution order will be shipped.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Order type that controls how the planned distribution order created from this inbox record is processed.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Category indicating the type of reference order linked to the planned distribution order, such as customer or manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number related to the planned distribution order represented by this inbox record.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order associated with the planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order line associated with the planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: PLHM
inputParameters.description: Planning time within the planning date when this planned distribution order affects the material plan.

inputParameters.name: ORQA
inputParameters.description: Ordered quantity for this planned distribution order expressed in an alternate unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: SUBN
inputParameters.description: Identifier of the planning subnetwork to which this planned distribution order belongs.

inputParameters.name: SUBD
inputParameters.description: Due date for the planning subnetwork to which this planned distribution order belongs.

inputParameters.name: TRDY
inputParameters.description: Planned transportation lead time in workdays between the supplying and receiving warehouses for this planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: TRTE
inputParameters.description: Planned transportation time in hours and minutes between the supplying and receiving warehouses for this planned distribution order.

inputParameters.name: MACN
inputParameters.description: Macro order ID that groups this planned distribution order within a macro planning structure.

inputParameters.name: BJNO
inputParameters.description: Batch job number generated by GetJobNumber that groups the inbox records belonging to the same update job.

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method to use for the shipment on the planned distribution order created or updated from this inbox record.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms defining when responsibility for the shipment on this planned distribution order is transferred between parties.
